The '''Bright Jewel sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]. It contained several habitable systems, including the [[Aleen system/Legends|Aleen system]], the [[Anobis system/Legends|Anobis system]] and the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]], whose capital [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] became the commercial hub of the sector, as well as of the neighbouring [[Dohu sector/Legends|Dohu]] and [[Qiilura sector/Legends|Qiilura sector]]. 

The Bright Jewel sector was also the hub of the [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]], which also contained the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="TEA" />
